newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH PX50 CLOSES LOWER IN NERVOUS MARKET.
newsitem.headline: CZECH PX50 CLOSES LOWER IN NERVOUS MARKET.

text.p: 1500 GMT - Czech PX50 closes lower on Wednesday led by blue chips. Activity very thin.
* On bourse as whole, 174 shares rise, 180 fall, 110 unchanged. Turnover,640 million crowns, volume, 828,189 shares.
The Czech PX50 fell back on Wednesday as a mood of indecison enveloped the market and dealers nervously waited for someone to take a firm lead.
The PX50 lost 5.1 points, 0.9 percent to 553.4 while the RPIX index dropped 15.2 points, 1.3 percent, to 1,152.7.
"People are definitely waiting for some kind of direction ...It's a wait and see market," said Lubomir Vystavel of ING Barings.
Ivan Kusacek, a dealer at Zivnostenska Banka agreed but took a more bearish line. "I'm not very optimistic and I still don't see big interest from foreigners," he said.

Dealers said the fate of SPT Telecom, which accounts for 21 percent of index capitalisation, was still undecided as analysts continue to mull the company's 1996 results which according to international accounting standards showed a loss of 483 million crowns. SPT recovered from heavy early losses to close down 35 crowns to 3,390.

Vystavel said there were currently two evenly divided groups -- pessimists and optimists -- battling for control of the issue's direction. "At the moment they are battling...and it will take a long time," he said.
